1: -module(quod_names_SUITE).
    2: 
    3: %% `quod:names` on real nodes. The target peer hosts quod:names, quod:root
    4: %% and a small agent ontology; the asker peer hosts only its own ontology and
    5: %% reaches quod:names through an ordinary directory route (the non-hosting
    6: %% remote case). Every draw here runs the real '$quod_draw'/3 inside the real
    7: %% proof machinery: origin worker, co-hosted scope, remote scope.
    8: 
    9: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
   10: -include_lib("stdlib/include/assert.hrl").
   11: 
   12: -export([all/0, init_per_suite/1, end_per_suite/1]).
   13: -export([remote_completion_of_deep_proof/1,
   14:          cohosted_draw_labels_an_agent/1,
   15:          remote_draw_from_non_hosting_node/1,
   16:          public_queries_open_mutation_refused/1,
   17:          creator_narrows_the_policy/1,
   18:          backtracking_cut_and_savepoint/1,
   19:          restart_recovery/1,
   20:          cold_peer_joins_quod_names/1,
   21:          founder_restarts_and_replays/1]).
   22: 
   23: -define(TARGET_PORT, 15990).
   24: -define(ASKER_PORT, 15991).
   25: -define(ROOT_NS, <<"quod:root">>).
   26: -define(NAMES_NS, <<"quod:names">>).
   27: -define(AGENT_NS, <<"naming-agent">>).
   28: -define(ASKER_NS, <<"naming-asker">>).
   29: -define(NAMES, {':', quod, names}).
   30: 
   31: all() -> [remote_completion_of_deep_proof,
   32:           cohosted_draw_labels_an_agent,
   33:           remote_draw_from_non_hosting_node,
   34:           public_queries_open_mutation_refused,
   35:           creator_narrows_the_policy,
   36:           backtracking_cut_and_savepoint,
   37:           restart_recovery,
   38:           cold_peer_joins_quod_names,
   39:           founder_restarts_and_replays].
   40: 
   41: init_per_suite(Config) ->
   42:     {TargetPub, _} = TargetKey = quod_identity:generate(),
   43:     {AskerPub, _} = AskerKey = quod_identity:generate(),
   44:     TargetAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?TARGET_PORT},
   45:     AskerAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT},
   46:     Names = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/quod_names.pl"),
   47:     AgentGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "naming_agent.pl"),
   48:     ok = file:write_file(
   49:            AgentGenesis,
   50:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _CallChain, _Ns).\n"
   51:             "can_join(_Ns, _Addr, Pk) :- peer_ready(Pk).\n"
   52:             "label_me(Salt, Name) :- quod:names::draw(Salt, Name).\n"]),
   53:     AskerGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "naming_asker.pl"),
   54:     ok = file:write_file(
   55:            AskerGenesis,
   56:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _CallChain, _Ns).\n"
   57:             "can_join(_Ns, _Addr, Pk) :- peer_ready(Pk).\n"
   58:             "remote_label(Salt, Name) :- quod:names::draw(Salt, Name).\n"]),
   59:     Target = start_node(names_target, ?TARGET_PORT, TargetKey, Config),
   60:     start_root_namespace(Target, TargetPub, Config, names_target),
   61:     start_namespace(Target, TargetPub, ?NAMES_NS, Names, Config, names_target),
   62:     start_namespace(Target, TargetPub, ?AGENT_NS, AgentGenesis, Config, names_target),
   63:     Asker = start_node(names_asker, ?ASKER_PORT, AskerKey, Config),
   64:     start_namespace(Asker, AskerPub, ?ASKER_NS, AskerGenesis, Config),
   65:     RootAnchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ROOT_NS]),
   66:     NamesAnchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NAMES_NS]),
   67:     lists:foreach(fun(Peer) -> set_network_identity(Peer, RootAnchor) end,
   68:                   [Target, Asker]),
   69:     ok = wait_ready(Target, ?NAMES_NS, {count, <<"halfling">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>, {'_'}}),
   70:     ok = wait_ready(Target, ?AGENT_NS, true),
   71:     ok = wait_ready(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, true),
   72:     NamesCount = count(Target, ?NAMES_NS),
   73:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_quic, learn, [TargetPub, TargetAddr]),
   74:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
   75:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
   76:                 [TargetPub, TargetAddr,
   77:                  [{?NAMES_NS, NamesAnchor, validator},
   78:                   {?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
   79:     [{target, Target}, {asker, Asker}, {target_pub, TargetPub},
   80:      {target_key, TargetKey}, {asker_pub, AskerPub}, {target_addr, TargetAddr},
   81:      {asker_addr, AskerAddr}, {names_anchor, NamesAnchor},
   82:      {names_source, Names}, {names_count, NamesCount}, {agent_genesis, AgentGenesis} | Config].
   83: 
   84: end_per_suite(Config) ->
   85:     quod_ct:stop_all([?config(target, Config), ?config(asker, Config)]),
   86:     quod_ct:stop_all(persistent_term:get({?MODULE, restarted}, [])).
   87: 
   88: %% Exhausting a remote draw sends the target's bounded failure stack back
   89: %% with the completion. The asker knows none of quod:names' predicate names,
   90: %% so every reason arrives as opaque symbols; a stack the target filled to
   91: %% the wire cap must still be accepted here (quod_ask checked_completion).
   92: remote_completion_of_deep_proof(Config) ->
   93:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
   94:     lists:foreach(
   95:       fun(Salt) ->
   96:               Result = quod_ct:peer_prove(
   97:                          Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
   98:                          {findall, {'N'},
   99:                           {';', {'::', ?NAMES, {draw, {deep, Salt}, {'N'}}}, true},
  100:                           {'L'}}),
  101:               ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [Name, _]}], _} when is_binary(Name),
  102:                            Result, {salt, Salt})
  103:       end, lists:seq(1, 40)).
  104: 
  105: %% An ontology on the same node asks quod:names inside a write and keeps the
  106: %% answer as an ordinary fact; quod:names itself stays untouched.
  107: cohosted_draw_labels_an_agent(Config) ->
  108:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  109:     Before = count(Target, ?NAMES_NS),
  110:     Goal = {',', {label_me, {agent, 1}, {'N'}},
  111:             {assertz, {attribute, me, display_name, {'N'}}}},
  112:     {ok, [#{'N' := Label}], _} = execute(Target, ?AGENT_NS, Goal),
  113:     ?assert(is_binary(Label)),
  114:     ?assertNotEqual([], classes(Target, ?NAMES_NS, Label)),
  115:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := Label}], _},
  116:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(Target, ?AGENT_NS,
  117:                                     {attribute, me, display_name, {'L'}})),
  118:     %% Another proof is another draw: still a name, kept as its own label.
  119:     {ok, [#{'N' := Other}], _} =
  120:         execute(Target, ?AGENT_NS,
  121:                 {',', {label_me, {agent, 1}, {'N'}},
  122:                  {assertz, {attribute, other, display_name, {'N'}}}}),
  123:     ?assertNotEqual([], classes(Target, ?NAMES_NS, Other)),
  124:     ?assertEqual(Before, count(Target, ?NAMES_NS)),
  125:     %% quod:names has an attribute/3 of its own now, the class view over its
  126:     %% pools, so what matters is that the agent's label did not leak into it.
  127:     ?assertMatch({fail, _},
  128:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(Target, ?NAMES_NS,
  129:                                     {attribute, me, display_name, {'_'}})),
  130:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'S' := Size}], _} when is_integer(Size),
  131:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(
  132:                    Target, ?NAMES_NS,
  133:                    {attribute, {pool, <<"orc">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>}, size, {'S'}})).
  134: 
  135: %% The asker hosts nothing of quod:names; its draws travel to the target and
  136: %% are answered by the real scope there, with the asker's proof identity.
  137: remote_draw_from_non_hosting_node(Config) ->
  138:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  139:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  140:     ?assertEqual(undefined,
  141:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, ?NAMES_NS}])),
  142:     Started = erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond),
  143:     {ok, [#{'N' := Name}], _} =
  144:         quod_ct:peer_prove(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, {remote_label, s1, {'N'}}),
  145:     Elapsed = erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond) - Started,
  146:     ct:pal("remote draw from non-hosting node: ~p ms -> ~p", [Elapsed, Name]),
  147:     ?assert(is_binary(Name)),
  148:     ?assertNotEqual([], classes(Target, ?NAMES_NS, Name)),
  149:     %% The same question twice in one proof is one answer; a selection stays
  150:     %% inside its pools; counts and recognition cross the wire too.
  151:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [Same, Same]}], _},
  152:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(
  153:                    Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
  154:                    {findall, {'N'},
  155:                     {';', {remote_label, s2, {'N'}}, {remote_label, s2, {'N'}}},
  156:                     {'L'}})),
  157:     {ok, [#{'N' := Elf}], _} =
  158:         quod_ct:peer_prove(Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
  159:                            {'::', ?NAMES, {draw, <<"elf">>, <<"personal">>, <<"female">>, s3, {'N'}}}),
  160:     ?assert(lists:member({<<"elf">>, <<"personal">>, <<"female">>}, classes(Target, ?NAMES_NS, Elf))),
  161:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'C' := 384}], _},
  162:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(
  163:                    Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
  164:                    {'::', ?NAMES, {count, <<"halfling">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>, {'C'}}})),
  165:     %% Cultures are binaries: nothing to allocate on the asker.
  166:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [<<"orc">>]}], _},
  167:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(
  168:                    Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
  169:                    {findall, {'C'},
  170:                     {'::', ?NAMES, {name, <<"Ugbash">>, {'C'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}},
  171:                     {'L'}})),
  172:     Timings = [begin
  173:                    T0 = erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond),
  174:                    {ok, [#{'N' := _}], _} =
  175:                        quod_ct:peer_prove(Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
  176:                                           {remote_label, {t, I}, {'N'}}),
  177:                    erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond) - T0
  178:                end || I <- lists:seq(1, 5)],
  179:     ct:pal("remote draw latencies (ms): ~p", [Timings]).
  180: 
  181: %% Anyone may ask; nobody but an admitted node may change the tables.
  182: public_queries_open_mutation_refused(Config) ->
  183:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  184:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  185:     Before = count(Target, ?NAMES_NS),
  186:     Refused = fun(Inner) ->
  187:                       Result = quod_ct:peer_prove(
  188:                                  Asker, ?ASKER_NS, {'::', ?NAMES, Inner}),
  189:                       ?assertNotMatch({ok, _, _}, Result),
  190:                       Result
  191:               end,
  192:     Refused({assertz, {elements, <<"zz">>, [<<"zzz">>]}}),
  193:     Refused({',', {name, {'N'}, <<"orc">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>},
  194:              {assertz, {elements, <<"zz">>, [<<"zzz">>]}}}),
  195:     Refused({retract, {pool, <<"orc">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>, {'_'}}}),
  196:     Refused({assertz, {naming_query, {assertz, {'_'}}}}),
  197:     ?assertEqual(Before, count(Target, ?NAMES_NS)),
  198:     ?assertMatch({fail, _},
  199:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(Target, ?NAMES_NS, {elements, <<"zz">>, {'_'}})),
  200:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'N' := _}], _},
  201:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(
  202:                    Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
  203:                    {'::', ?NAMES, {name_nth, <<"orc">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>, 0, {'N'}}})).
  204: 
  205: %% After founding, the creator narrows the policy with one ordinary write:
  206: %% the creating node alone changes the tables, other ontologies read them
  207: %% through their own proofs, and the naming questions stay open to anyone.
  208: creator_narrows_the_policy(Config) ->
  209:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  210:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  211:     TargetPub = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  212:     Before = count(Target, ?NAMES_NS),
  213:     {ok, _, _} = execute(Target, ?NAMES_NS, creator_policy(TargetPub)),
  214:     %% The admitted-node clause is gone; the policy is the creator's.
  215:     ?assert(failed(quod_ct:peer_prove(
  216:                      Target, ?NAMES_NS,
  217:                      {clause, {can_invoke, {'_'}, {node, {'K'}}, {'_'}, {'_'}},
  218:                       {peer_admitted, {'K'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'K'}}}))),
  219:     Policy = fun(Goal, Principal, Chain) ->
  220:                      quod_ct:peer_prove(
  221:                        Target, ?NAMES_NS,
  222:                        {can_invoke, Goal, Principal, Chain, ?NAMES_NS})
  223:              end,
  224:     Write = {assertz, {elements, <<"zz">>, [<<"zzz">>]}},
  225:     {OtherPub, _} = quod_identity:generate(),
  226:     %% Every caller that is not this host arrives with its origin ahead of it
  227:     %% (a non-empty call chain). Writing there is the creator's alone.
  228:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, Policy(Write, {node, TargetPub}, [?ASKER_NS])),
  229:     ?assert(failed(Policy(Write, {node, OtherPub}, [?ASKER_NS]))),
  230:     ?assert(failed(Policy(Write, anonymous, [?ASKER_NS]))),
  231:     %% Reading the tables is open to them; before this write it was not.
  232:     Table = {pool, <<"orc">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>, {'_'}},
  233:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, Policy(Table, anonymous, [?ASKER_NS])),
  234:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, Policy({isa, <<"orc">>, {'_'}}, anonymous, [?ASKER_NS])),
  235:     %% The naming questions stay open to anyone, as before.
  236:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, Policy({draw, s, {'_'}}, anonymous, [?ASKER_NS])),
  237:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _},
  238:                  Policy({count, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}, anonymous, [?ASKER_NS])),
  239:     %% An empty chain is this host's own top-level proof, which founding
  240:     %% admits unconditionally in every ontology (quod_simplex host entry).
  241:     %% This write does not touch that, so it stays true of quod:names too.
  242:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, Policy(Write, {node, TargetPub}, [])),
  243:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, Policy(Write, anonymous, [])),
  244:     %% Another ontology reads the tables and draws; it still cannot write.
  245:     %% Compare the recipe's wire value: the shared eidolon vocabulary may
  246:     %% already know its symbols, independently of the remote naming policy.
  247:     {ok, [#{'S' := Recipe}], _} = quod_ct:peer_prove(
  248:         Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
  249:         {'::', ?NAMES, {pool, <<"orc">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>, {'S'}}}),
  250:     ?assertEqual(quod_wire_term:encode({recipe, {concat,
  251:                      [{element, <<"vile_medium">>}, {element, <<"vile_medium">>}]}}),
  252:                  quod_wire_term:encode(Recipe)),
  253:     %% isa/2 is reflexive and transitive. Test the permitted ancestor read,
  254:     %% independently of which valid answer an unbound query returns first.
  255:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
  256:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(
  257:                    Asker, ?ASKER_NS, {'::', ?NAMES, {isa, <<"orc">>, <<"vile">>}})),
  258:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'N' := Name}], _} when is_binary(Name),
  259:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, {remote_label, policy, {'N'}})),
  260:     ?assertNotMatch({ok, _, _},
  261:                     quod_ct:peer_prove(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, {'::', ?NAMES, Write})),
  262:     %% The creator writes: a private table joins the public ones.
  263:     {ok, _, _} = execute(Target, ?NAMES_NS,
  264:                          {',', {assertz, {isa, <<"testfolk">>, <<"thing">>}},
  265:                           {',', {assertz, {pool, <<"testfolk">>, <<"personal">>, <<"any">>, listed}},
  266:                            {assertz, {listed, <<"testfolk">>, <<"personal">>, <<"any">>,
  267:                                       [<<"Ada">>, <<"Bo">>, <<"Cy">>]}}}}),
  268:     ?assertEqual(Before + 3, count(Target, ?NAMES_NS)),
  269:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'N' := <<"Bo">>}], _},
  270:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(
  271:                    Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
  272:                    {'::', ?NAMES, {name_nth, <<"testfolk">>, <<"personal">>, <<"any">>, 1, {'N'}}})),
  273:     %% and takes it away again: the tables the other cases see are the ones
  274:     %% the ontology was founded with.
  275:     {ok, _, _} = execute(Target, ?NAMES_NS,
  276:                          {',', {retract, {isa, <<"testfolk">>, <<"thing">>}},
  277:                           {',', {retract, {pool, <<"testfolk">>, <<"personal">>, <<"any">>, listed}},
  278:                            {retract, {listed, <<"testfolk">>, <<"personal">>, <<"any">>, {'_'}}}}}),
  279:     ?assertEqual(Before, count(Target, ?NAMES_NS)),
  280:     ?assertMatch({fail, _},
  281:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(
  282:                    Target, ?NAMES_NS,
  283:                    {pool, <<"testfolk">>, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}})).
  284: 
  285: failed(fail) -> true;
  286: failed({fail, _Reasons}) -> true;
  287: failed(_) -> false.
  288: 
  289: %% The one write the creator submits after founding, on the live fleet as
  290: %% here (see the handoff runbook).
  291: creator_policy(CreatorKey) ->
  292:     {',', {assertz, {creator, {node, CreatorKey}}},
  293:      {',', {assertz, {':-', {can_invoke, {'_'}, {'P'}, {'_'}, {'_'}},
  294:                       {creator, {'P'}}}},
  295:       {',', {assertz, {':-', {can_invoke, {'G'}, {'_'}, [{'_'} | {'_'}], {'_'}},
  296:                        {table_query, {'G'}}}},
  297:        {',', {assertz, {table_query, {isa, {'_'}, {'_'}}}},
  298:         {',', {assertz, {table_query, {pool, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}}},
  299:          {',', {assertz, {table_query, {listed, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}}},
  300:           {',', {assertz, {table_query, {elements, {'_'}, {'_'}}}},
  301:            {retract, {':-', {can_invoke, {'_'}, {node, {'K'}}, {'_'}, {'_'}},
  302:                       {peer_admitted, {'K'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'K'}}}}}}}}}}}.
  303: 
  304: %% Backtracking re-asks and re-hears the same answer; a cut keeps it; a
  305: %% rolled-back candidate that drew changes nothing for the draw after it.
  306: backtracking_cut_and_savepoint(Config) ->
  307:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  308:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [A, B, A]}], _} when A =/= B,
  309:                  execute(Target, ?AGENT_NS,
  310:                          {findall, {'N'},
  311:                           {',', {member, {'S'}, [a, b, a]},
  312:                            {label_me, {'S'}, {'N'}}}, {'L'}})),
  313:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [_]}], _},
  314:                  execute(Target, ?AGENT_NS,
  315:                          {findall, {'N'},
  316:                           {',', {member, {'S'}, [a, b]},
  317:                            {',', {label_me, {'S'}, {'N'}}, '!'}}, {'L'}})),
  318:     Goal = {',', {label_me, a, {'N1'}},
  319:             {',', {';', {transaction,
  320:                          {',', {assertz, {rolled, {'N1'}}}, fail}},
  321:                    true},
  322:              {',', {label_me, a, {'N2'}},
  323:               {',', {'==', {'N1'}, {'N2'}},
  324:                {assertz, {kept, {'N2'}}}}}}},
  325:     {ok, [#{'N1' := N, 'N2' := N}], _} = execute(Target, ?AGENT_NS, Goal),
  326:     ?assertMatch({fail, _},
  327:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(Target, ?AGENT_NS, {rolled, {'_'}})),
  328:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
  329:                  quod_ct:peer_prove(Target, ?AGENT_NS, {kept, N})).
  330: 
  331: %% quod:names comes back after its engine dies, on the host and for the
  332: %% remote asker alike.
  333: restart_recovery(Config) ->
  334:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  335:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  336:     OldSimplex = peer:call(Target, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?NAMES_NS}]),
  337:     OldEngine = peer:call(Target, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, ?NAMES_NS}]),
  338:     ?assert(is_pid(OldSimplex) andalso is_pid(OldEngine)),
  339:     true = peer:call(Target, erlang, exit, [OldEngine, kill]),
  340:     true = peer:call(Target, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
  341:     ok = wait_restarted(Target, ?NAMES_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
  342:     ok = wait_ready(Target, ?NAMES_NS, {count, <<"halfling">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>, {'_'}}),
  343:     ?assertEqual(?config(names_anchor, Config),
  344:                  peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NAMES_NS])),
  345:     {ok, [#{'N' := Local}], _} =
  346:         execute(Target, ?AGENT_NS, {label_me, after_restart, {'N'}}),
  347:     ?assertNotEqual([], classes(Target, ?NAMES_NS, Local)),
  348:     ?assert(quod_ct:eventually(
  349:               fun() ->
  350:                       case quod_ct:peer_prove(Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
  351:                                               {remote_label, after_restart, {'N'}}) of
  352:                           {ok, [#{'N' := Remote}], _} -> is_binary(Remote);
  353:                           _ -> false
  354:                       end
  355:               end, 30000)).
  356: 
  357: %% The asker never loaded the naming source: joining quod:names makes it
  358: %% decode the genesis over the wire as a cold receiver and then answer draws
  359: %% itself.
  360: cold_peer_joins_quod_names(Config) ->
  361:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  362:     AskerPub = ?config(asker_pub, Config),
  363:     TargetAddr = ?config(target_addr, Config),
  364:     Anchor = ?config(names_anchor, Config),
  365:     ?assertEqual(undefined,
  366:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, ?NAMES_NS}])),
  367:     DataDir = filename:join(
  368:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
  369:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
  370:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Asker, erlang, node, [])), "_join_", ?NAMES_NS])),
  371:     %% The directory is one an earlier join attempt left behind: that joiner
  372:     %% pinned another anchor, refused every page the target served and was
  373:     %% stopped with its ledger still empty. The recreated ontology joins
  374:     %% into the same directory.
  375:     StaleCfg = #{node_id => AskerPub, mode => join,
  376:                  genesis_hash => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  377:                  data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => [TargetAddr]},
  378:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Asker, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [?NAMES_NS, StaleCfg]),
  379:     %% Starting is what shapes the directory: the empty ledger and the
  380:     %% signing journal bound to the wrong anchor exist before any page is
  381:     %% served, and no page under that pin can ever be appended.
  382:     ?assertMatch(#{syncing := true, slot := 0},
  383:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, status, [?NAMES_NS])),
  384:     ?assertMatch(#{slot := 0, appends := 0, submitted := 0},
  385:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, stats, [?NAMES_NS])),
  386:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_ns_sup, stop_namespace, [?NAMES_NS]),
  387:     ?assertEqual(undefined,
  388:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, ?NAMES_NS}])),
  389:     Cfg = StaleCfg#{genesis_hash => Anchor},
  390:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Asker, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [?NAMES_NS, Cfg]),
  391:     ok = wait_ready(Asker, ?NAMES_NS, {count, <<"halfling">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>, {'_'}}),
  392:     ?assertEqual(Anchor, peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NAMES_NS])),
  393:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer, syncing := false},
  394:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, status, [?NAMES_NS])),
  395:     ?assertEqual(?config(names_count, Config), count(Asker, ?NAMES_NS)),
  396:     {ok, [#{'N' := Name}], _} =
  397:         execute(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, {remote_label, cold_join, {'N'}}),
  398:     ?assert(is_binary(Name)),
  399:     ?assertNotEqual([], classes(Asker, ?NAMES_NS, Name)).
  400: 
  401: %% The founder's VM restarts with its data directories kept: quod:names
  402: %% replays its own genesis from the ledger — the same cold decode a joiner
  403: %% does — and answers again, locally and for the asker.
  404: founder_restarts_and_replays(Config) ->
  405:     Old = ?config(target, Config),
  406:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  407:     TargetPub = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  408:     Anchor = ?config(names_anchor, Config),
  409:     ok = peer:stop(Old),
  410:     Target = start_node(names_target_restarted, ?TARGET_PORT,
  411:                         ?config(target_key, Config), Config),
  412:     persistent_term:put({?MODULE, restarted}, [Target]),
  413:     %% Same data directories as the first VM: every namespace resumes.
  414:     start_root_namespace(Target, TargetPub, Config, names_target),
  415:     start_namespace(Target, TargetPub, ?NAMES_NS, ?config(names_source, Config),
  416:                     Config, names_target),
  417:     start_namespace(Target, TargetPub, ?AGENT_NS, ?config(agent_genesis, Config),
  418:                     Config, names_target),
  419:     RootAnchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ROOT_NS]),
  420:     set_network_identity(Target, RootAnchor),
  421:     ok = wait_ready(Target, ?NAMES_NS, {count, <<"halfling">>, <<"personal">>, <<"male">>, {'_'}}),
  422:     ok = wait_ready(Target, ?AGENT_NS, true),
  423:     ?assertEqual(Anchor, peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NAMES_NS])),
  424:     ?assertEqual(?config(names_count, Config), count(Target, ?NAMES_NS)),
  425:     {ok, [#{'N' := Local}], _} =
  426:         execute(Target, ?AGENT_NS, {label_me, after_vm_restart, {'N'}}),
  427:     ?assertNotEqual([], classes(Target, ?NAMES_NS, Local)),
  428:     ?assert(quod_ct:eventually(
  429:               fun() ->
  430:                       case quod_ct:peer_prove(Asker, ?ASKER_NS,
  431:                                               {remote_label, after_vm_restart, {'N'}}) of
  432:                           {ok, [#{'N' := Remote}], _} -> is_binary(Remote);
  433:                           _ -> false
  434:                       end
  435:               end, 30000)).
  436: 
  437: %% --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
  438: 
  439: execute(Peer, Ns, Goal) ->
  440:     peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, execute, [Ns, Goal], 60000).
  441: 
  442: count(Peer, Ns) ->
  443:     {ok, [#{'C' := C}], _} =
  444:         quod_ct:peer_prove(Peer, Ns, {count, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'C'}}),
  445:     C.
  446: 
  447: %% Every (culture, kind, gender) selection a name belongs to, one per pool.
  448: classes(Peer, Ns, Name) ->
  449:     {ok, [#{'L' := L}], _} =
  450:         quod_ct:peer_prove(Peer, Ns, {findall, {s, {'C'}, {'K'}, {'G'}},
  451:                                       {name, Name, {'C'}, {'K'}, {'G'}}, {'L'}}),
  452:     [{C, K, G} || {s, C, K, G} <- L].
  453: 
  454: start_node(Name, Port, {Pub, Seed}, Config) ->
  455:     %% Peer nodes must load the beam being tested (see quod_ask_SUITE).
  456:     QuodEbin = filename:dirname(code:which(quod_simplex)),
  457:     PeerPaths = [QuodEbin | lists:delete(QuodEbin, code:get_path())],
  458:     {ok, Peer, _Node} = peer:start(
  459:                           #{name => Name, connection => standard_io,
  460:                             args => ["-pa" | PeerPaths]}),
  461:     CacheDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config),
  462:                              atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_cache"),
  463:     true = peer:call(Peer, os, putenv, ["XDG_CACHE_HOME", CacheDir]),
  464:     _ = peer:call(Peer, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
  465:     _ = peer:call(Peer, application, load, [quod]),
  466:     Set = fun(K, V) -> ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end,
  467:     Set(listen_port, Port),
  468:     Set(node_addr, {"127.0.0.1", Port}),
  469:     Set(node_pubkey, Pub),
  470:     Set(identity_key, quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed})),
  471:     Set(identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert({Pub, Seed})),
  472:     Set(effect_journal_data_dir,
  473:         filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config),
  474:                       atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_effect_journal")),
  475:     Set(foreign_log,
  476:         #{cache_dir => filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config),
  477:                                      atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_foreign_log")}),
  478:     Set(directory, #{ttl_ms => 600000, expire_tick_ms => 60000}),
  479:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
  480:     Peer.
  481: 
  482: start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Config) ->
  483:     start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Config,
  484:                     peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])).
  485: 
  486: start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Config, DirKey) ->
  487:     DataDir = filename:join(
  488:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
  489:                 unicode:characters_to_list([atom_to_list(DirKey), "_", Ns])),
  490:     Cfg = #{node_id => Pub, mode => create, role => member,
  491:             data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => [], genesis_file => Genesis},
  492:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),
  493:     ok.
  494: 
  495: start_root_namespace(Peer, Pub, Config, DirKey) ->
  496:     DataDir = filename:join(
  497:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
  498:                 unicode:characters_to_list([atom_to_list(DirKey), "_", ?ROOT_NS])),
  499:     Content = #{namespace => ?ROOT_NS, mode => create,
  500:                 genesis_file => <<"ontologies/quod_root.pl">>,
  501:                 data_dir => list_to_binary(DataDir), seeds => []},
  502:     {?ROOT_NS, Cfg0} = peer:call(Peer, quod_app, build_ns_config, [Content]),
  503:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace,
  504:                         [?ROOT_NS, Cfg0#{node_id => Pub}]),
  505:     ok.
  506: 
  507: set_network_identity(Peer, NetworkId) ->
  508:     Desired = peer:call(Peer, application, get_env,
  509:                         [quod, namespace_desired, #{}]),
  510:     Content = maps:get(content, Desired, #{}),
  511:     ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env,
  512:                    [quod, namespace_desired,
  513:                     Desired#{content => Content#{
  514:                       quod_ontology:root_ns() => #{genesis_hash => NetworkId}}}]).
  515: 
  516: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal) -> wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, 750).
  517: 
  518: wait_ready(_Peer, Ns, _Goal, 0) -> ct:fail({ontology_never_ready, Ns});
  519: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries) ->
  520:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Goal], 5000) of
  521:         {ok, _, _} -> ok;
  522:         {error, rebuilding} -> timer:sleep(20), wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries - 1);
  523:         {error, no_such_namespace} -> timer:sleep(20), wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries - 1);
  524:         Other -> ct:fail({not_ready, Ns, Other})
  525:     end.
  526: 
  527: 
  528: wait_restarted(_Peer, _Ns, _OldSimplex, 0) -> ct:fail(namespace_did_not_restart);
  529: wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries) ->
  530:     Simplex = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, Ns}]),
  531:     Prolog = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, Ns}]),
  532:     case is_pid(Simplex) andalso Simplex =/= OldSimplex andalso is_pid(Prolog) of
  533:         true -> ok;
  534:         false -> timer:sleep(25), wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries - 1)
  535:     end.
